newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Great Eagle drops Tai Shan spin-off plan.
newsitem.headline: Great Eagle drops Tai Shan spin-off plan.

text.p: Great Eagle Holdings Ltd said in a statement published on Monday that it has decided not to proceed with a proposal to spin off its office and commercial property arm Tai Shan Properties Ltd.
The company said current market sentiment would not have allowed the Tai Shan issue to be priced at an attractive level.

"The directors reiterate that notwithstanding the decision not to proceed with the spin-off, Great Eagle will be able to obtain sufficient funding for its projects in hand, including the Mongkok project, as well as other investment plans," it added.

Great Eagle said last month that it planned to spin off the unit, raising up to HK$2.50 billion. Tai Shan had intended to use about HK$700 million of the net proceeds for the development of an office and commercial complex in Mongkok, Kowloon.
About HK$826.5 million would have been used to repay loans made by Great Eagle to finance the Mongkok project.

"The very strong economics of the Mongkok project will on its own support sufficient project financing, well within the normal lending criteria of major commercial banks in Hong Kong, to fund the project to completion," Great Eagle said in the statement.

The company, which was in the process of marketing the Tai Shan issue, said institutional investors were reluctant, at this time, to increase their weighting in Hong Kong stocks and property stocks in particular.

"In the past several weeks, sentiment towards the Hong Kong stock market and, in particular, Hong Kong property stocks, has deteriorated due to certain international events including heightened concerns regarding future interest rate rises following recent statements made by the chairman of the Federal Reserve in the United States," Great Eagle said.
It said lowering the issue price of the Tai Shan spin off would have resulted in an unacceptable level of dilution to Great Eagle.
